PROP-01b-partial-asm-001.text: Signature in invest() includes nonce or deadline to prevent replay across sales or time windows.
PROP-01b-partial-asm-001.assertion: forall sig in invest(): sig.params include (nonce OR deadline) AND (saleAddress OR chainId)

locations.note: message = keccak256(msg.sender, address(this), block.chainid); includes saleAddress+chainId but NO nonce or deadline
